Talent0_2Ability.name: Incredible Hacker
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: When both shoulders are equipped with Missile Launchers, you can use the <buf ID=900016>[Salvo]</buf> code to launch an attack, dealing <color=#F74848>2* 0.7x</color> DMG to the hit part and <color=#F74848>0.5x</color> Splash DMG to other parts.

Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects:
When both shoulders are equipped with Missile Launchers, able to use the <buf ID=900016>[Salvo]</buf> code to launch attack, deal <color=#F74848>2*0.7x</color> DMG to the hit part and <color=#F74848>0.5x</color> Splash DMG to other parts;
<buf ID=900016>[Salvo]</buf>-style skill DMG <color=#F74848>+15%</color>

400001.name: Strategic Bombing 1
400001.SpecificEffects: When a Tactical Weapon runs out of ammo, trigger <buf ID=900029>[Auto Load]</buf>. This process takes <color=#F74848>3</color> turns.

400502.name: Explosive Attack
400502.describe: Uses Missile Launcher to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.0x</color> DMG to 1 part and <color=#F74848>1x</color> Splash DMG to the other parts.

400503.name: Zero-Day Vulnerability
400503.SpecificEffects: When attacking with a Missile Launcher, if the target's HP is full, DMG <color=#F74848>+20%</color>.

400504.name: Cheating
400504.describe: Fully restore Missile Launcher Ammo and gain <color=#F74848>1</color> AP. Can continue the action with the remaining movement.

700015.name: Rotation
700015.SpecificEffects: At the end of the action, if no damage was dealt this turn, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP.

400506.name: Root Control
400506.describe: Access <buf ID=900025>[Rack]</buf> mode: unable to move, Missile Launcher's Range <color=#F74848> +1</color>, DMG <color=#F74848>+10%</color>. Can continue the attack after racking. Automatically exits <buf ID=900025>[Rack]</buf> mode when the arm is damaged. In <buf ID=900025>[Rack]</buf> mode, can cast <buf ID=900026>[Retract]</buf> code. After retracting, can continue to move.

400507.name: CP Boost
400507.SpecificEffects: When attacking with the Missile Launcher, AP Cost <color=#F74848>+1</color>, and DMG <color=#F74848>+20%</color>.

400508.name: Grand Performance
400508.describe: Simultaneously use 2 Missile Launchers to attack a target. The <color=#F74848>2</color> missiles will hit the same part, dealing <color=#F74848>2* 0.85x</color> DMG and <color=#F74848>0.5x</color> Splash DMG to other parts.

400031.name: Indiscriminate 1
400031.SpecificEffects: After the first attack with a Tactical Weapon each turn, <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> can be triggered, with Final DMG <color=#F74848>-30%</color>, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn. Unable to move before attacking.

400033.name: Strategic Bombing 4
400033.SpecificEffects: When <buf ID=900029>[Auto Load]</buf> is complete, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP.

400034.name: Indiscriminate 2
400034.SpecificEffects: When attacking with a Tactical Weapon for the first time each turn, for every <color=#F74848>1</color> AP cost, DMG <color=#F74848>+4%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>20%</color>.

400035.name: Indiscriminate 3
400035.SpecificEffects: When <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> is triggered, allow continued moving with the remaining movement.

400036.name: Indiscriminate 4
400036.SpecificEffects: After triggering <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>, it no longer reduces final damage.

400541.name: Ether Rats 1
400541.SpecificEffects: The damage multiplier for <buf ID=900016>[Salvo]</buf> is increased to <color=#F74848>2 * 0.75x</color>.

400043.name: Power Innovation 3
400043.SpecificEffects: When destroying a target, additionally restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

400545.name: Ether Rats 3
400545.SpecificEffects: When attacking with the first Ammo in the Missile Launcher magazine, DMG <color=#F74848>+20%</color>.

400546.name: Ether Rats 4
400546.SpecificEffects: When cast <buf ID=900016>[Salvo]</buf>-style skill, <color=#F74848>50%</color> chance to trigger, not consuming any Ammo
